info.description: Emoji reactions on announcements and wiki pages. Anchored by targetType + targetDocumentId (the target's documentId — stable across Strapi 5's delete+recreate publish cycle, issue #11). The deprecated targetId attribute was removed with #25; the DB column target_id deliberately stays behind ORPHANED as a rollback anchor — Strapi v5 WOULD drop it on boot (forceMigration defaults to true), which is why config/database.ts sets settings.forceMigration=false; dropping it is a later deliberate ops task, see docs/architecture.md §5.27. targetDocumentId is intentionally NOT required: pre-#11 rows could in theory carry NULL.
